entries.title: North-end 1 Line: Lynnwood, Mountlake Terrace, Shoreline
entries.lede: Added the Lynnwood Link corridor. B rides 1 Line to Westlake then RapidRide D. A uses I-5/405 to Kirkland for a 7:55 arrival.

new.text: Heather Ridge Lynnwood — 2BR $1,749–$1,805. Cheap; B is bus+Link.
Zinnia Shoreline — $2,485–$2,660, walk to 148th, garage EV.
The LINE / Verdant at 145th — MFTE + market; walk to Shoreline South.
Traxx / Terrace Station MLT — walk to Link, EV in garage, ~$2,795–$3,085.
Kinect Lynnwood — walk to Lynnwood City Center Link, ~$2,495.
Avalon Alderwood — best north-end drive to school (~18–32 min AM), weaker Link walk.
